description:
Broad search for a FULL sweep -- every hit on a topic (e.g. before memory_consolidate), not a conversational lookup (that is memory_search). Up to 128 results; requires 2+ keywords ("python" alone = too broad).

Scores: 30+ excellent, 20+ good, <20 weak.
Full sweep of a topic intersection. complete=false -> memory_retrieve(id).
Read 20+ memories on one topic? -> memory_consolidate a summary future sessions see first.
Auto-includes shared collections (fan-out).

collection_filter.description: Limit to one collection name, or "personal". Omit=all. A slug this namespace holds no grant on (even one the account can list elsewhere) returns 0 rows plus a no_grant explanation, never silence.

expand.description: Full content for all results (50K+ tokens). Dedicated large-context agents only.

name: memory_deep_search
